brands.name: 1-800-Flowers
brands.territoryDescription: You will not receive an exclusive territory. The agreement designates only the approved shop location, and you may face competition from other franchisees, company outlets, and other channels the franchisor controls.

brands.name: 1-800-Radiator & A/C
brands.territoryDescription: Franchisor designates a mutually approved Territory. The franchisee does not receive an exclusive territory. Franchisor will not establish or authorize another 1-800-RADIATOR & A/C Warehouse in the Territory or solicit or accept Warehouse orders there, except Chain Account activity and reserved alternative channels.

brands.name: 1-800 WATER DAMAGE
brands.territoryDescription: The franchisee does not receive an exclusive territory. The territory is specific ZIP codes, generally about 350,000 people, with protected advertising, TPA/NORA and call-center referrals, and office location, but other franchisees and company outlets may service customers inside it.

brands.name: 1 Percent Lists
brands.territoryDescription: Franchisee may operate only from an approved site and focus activity in a designated Target Marketing Area (often zip codes or a radius sized toward about 10,000 homes). The FDD states the franchisee receives neither an exclusive nor a protected territory, and no exclusive rights apply to the site or Target Marketing Area.

brands.name: 10X Business Advisor
brands.territoryDescription: The franchisor does not offer a territory or a specific location and may approve another advisor nearby. The franchisee receives no exclusive territory or exclusive right to any market or customers, and may not solicit a client already doing business with another 10X Business Advisor franchisee.

brands.name: 180 Water
brands.territoryDescription: One outlet in a limited protected territory defined by zip codes, a radial map, or similar boundaries. While the franchisee is not in default, the franchisor will not open or grant another 180 Water outlet in the Territory, but reserves alternative channels, pre-existing clients, and referral-source sales.

brands.name: 1Heart Caregiver Services
brands.territoryDescription: Franchisor designates an exclusive Territory. The franchised business must operate from one approved, staffed site inside the Territory or Territories and may not relocate without prior written consent.

brands.name: FranNet
brands.territoryDescription: FranNet does not grant an exclusive or protected territory. The franchisee may work with prospects regardless of domicile, except legacy franchisees' exclusive or protected territories restrict some prospects, and an annual production quota applies.

brands.name: 30 Minute Hit
brands.territoryDescription: Franchise is for an approved Site inside a Designated Area, generally about a 10-minute drive time. While in compliance, the franchisor will not grant or operate a fixed-location 30 MINUTE HIT Gym in that area, except Non-Public Access Venues. The FDD states the franchisee does not receive an exclusive territory.

brands.name: 360 Tour Designs
brands.territoryDescription: The franchisee may operate one outlet in a limited protected area of contiguous ZIP codes with a minimum population of 250,000. While the franchisee is not in default, the franchisor will not open or authorize another 360 Tour Designs outlet in that area, but the franchisee does not receive an exclusive territory.

brands.name: 9Round
brands.territoryDescription: You will not receive an exclusive territory. During the term, neither the franchisor nor affiliates will develop or grant a 9ROUND Center physically located in the Designated Area, which stays constant for the initial term once defined.

brands.name: Golden Krust
brands.territoryDescription: The franchise is for one approved site only. No exclusive territory, option, or right of first refusal is granted, and the franchisor may open other restaurants elsewhere and sell through other channels without compensation.

brands.name: 360clean
brands.territoryDescription: You receive a territory, typically a metropolitan area with at least 100,000 population, and may operate only inside it. The territory is not exclusive, more than one franchisee may operate in it based on market share, and the franchisor reserves the right to establish businesses and sell competing products anywhere, including inside the territory.

brands.name: Abra
brands.territoryDescription: The franchisee receives a Protected Area equal to a one-mile radius in which Abra will not open another franchised or company-owned Abra Repair Center. Abra states this is not an exclusive territory and reserves other brands and alternate channels inside that area.

brands.name: Amazing Explorers Academy
brands.territoryDescription: The franchise is for one approved location. AEA DEV grants a protected territory, mapped by streets, highways, or driving distance from demographics, and will not open or franchise another academy there while the franchisee is in full compliance. The grant is not an exclusive territory.

brands.name: All County Property Management Franchise Corp
ANI
brands.territoryDescription: The franchise is for one approved site only. The franchisee does not receive an exclusive territory, and the franchisor may own or franchise ANI Offices anywhere, including next to the approved location.

brands.name: Image360
brands.territoryDescription: Franchisor will not operate or grant a new Image360, Signs By Tomorrow, or Signs Now center whose premises are inside a pre-determined Protected Territory, typically 4,000 to 5,000 businesses, but the franchisee does not receive an exclusive territory and others may solicit inside it.

brands.name: Alloy
brands.territoryDescription: The franchisee operates only at an approved location and does not receive an exclusive territory, but receives a protected Designated Area of at least 30,000 people in which the franchisor will not establish or allow another Alloy facility, subject to possible boundary overlap.

brands.name: Alloy Wheel Repair Specialists
brands.territoryDescription: Franchisee receives a protected geographic territory, typically one or more counties, and the franchisor will not place another same-mark outlet in it. The grant is not exclusive; alternative channels, national accounts, and other concepts are reserved, and protection depends on minimum annual gross revenue.

brands.name: Alpha Fit Club
brands.territoryDescription: After site approval, the franchisor designates a territory, generally about three miles by road from each studio, with no minimum size. It is not exclusive, but while the franchisee is not in default the franchisor will not open or authorize another Alpha Fit Club studio in that territory, subject to reserved rights.

brands.name: AlphaGraphics
brands.territoryDescription: You will not receive an exclusive territory. If you are in compliance, the franchisor will not establish or franchise another AlphaGraphics Center inside your Protected Area, generally about 6,000 businesses, but all parties may advertise and solicit customers anywhere, including inside that area.

brands.name: Amazing Lash Studio
brands.territoryDescription: The franchisee gets no exclusive territory, only a non-exclusive Search Territory for site selection. If in compliance, the franchisor will not operate or authorize Studios in a Protected Area, typically a 1.5-mile radius around the Studio.

brands.name: Bach to Rock
brands.territoryDescription: The franchise is for one approved premises. If the franchisee is in compliance, the franchisor will not open or license another Bach to Rock School in a designated Territory, typically at least about 5,000 households with children. The FDD states this is not an exclusive territory and reserves other rights inside it.

brands.name: AMRAMP
brands.territoryDescription: Franchisee receives a protected geographic territory, typically about two million people, and the franchisor will not open or license another Amramp business in that territory. The territory is not exclusive; the franchisor and affiliates retain other distribution rights.

brands.name: AmSpirit Business Connections
brands.territoryDescription: The franchise is granted for a non-exclusive Franchised Area designated by the franchisor. The franchisor may grant other franchises or operate company-owned businesses inside or outside that area, and the franchisee does not receive an exclusive territory.

brands.name: Anchored Tiny Homes
brands.territoryDescription: Franchisee receives one designated operating territory, generally a geographic area of up to 300,000 people. It is not exclusive, but while the franchisee is not in default the franchisor will not open or authorize another Anchored Tiny Homes Business in that territory, subject to reserved rights.

brands.name: Angry Chickz
brands.territoryDescription: Item 11 refers to a Protected Area sized using demographics, population, neighboring tenants, visibility, and proximity. The provided Item 12 text is the Item 9 obligations table, not the territory grant.

brands.name: Angus Valley Montessori
brands.territoryDescription: Territory designation from Item 12: 'exclusive'.

brands.name: Anytime Fitness
brands.territoryDescription: You operate one Anytime Fitness center at an approved site. After site approval you receive a protected territory, but not an exclusive territory, and you may face competition from other franchisees, company outlets, and other channels or brands the franchisor controls.

brands.name: Appell Striping
brands.territoryDescription: Franchisee receives a Protected Territory of approximately 500,000, drawn on geographic or political boundaries. While the franchisee is not in default, the franchisor and affiliates will not operate or authorize another Appell franchised business in that territory. National Account sites are excluded.

brands.name: ApTask
brands.territoryDescription: No specific territory is granted and the franchise is not exclusive. The franchisee may locate the office without restriction and may sell ApTask services anywhere in the United States, and may face competition from other franchisees, franchisor outlets, or other channels.

brands.name: Archadeck
brands.territoryDescription: The franchisee is granted a protected Territory set by demographics, typically under 600,000 people. The franchisor will not operate or grant a competing business in that Territory unless minimum annual sales quotas are missed, in which case it may add franchises, shrink the Territory, or terminate.

brands.name: Arthur Murray
brands.territoryDescription: No exclusive area is granted, and other franchisees or channels may compete. If a Market Area is designated, the franchisor will not operate or allow another Arthur Murray Studio in it during the term unless territorial protection is ended for missed development or an uncured breach, and the franchisee must operate only inside that area.

brands.name: Tire Pros
brands.territoryDescription: The franchisee receives no exclusive territory and no geographic territorial rights or protections. The grant is only the right to operate a Center at a specific approved retail location.

brands.name: @properties
brands.territoryDescription: The agreement may grant a Protected Territory, typically counties, zip codes, or other areas, in which the franchisor and other franchisees will not open another @properties office while the franchisee is in compliance. If none is designated, no territory is granted, and the franchisee does not receive an exclusive territory.

brands.name: ATAX
brands.territoryDescription: The franchisee receives an exclusive territory defined by zip codes or natural or political boundaries, normally covering 30,000-33,000 residents. The franchisor will not establish a company-owned or franchised outlet selling the same or similar goods or services under the same or similar marks in that area, while reserving other channels and affiliate rights.

brands.name: ATC Healthcare Services
brands.territoryDescription: The franchisee receives a protected Territory of at least 500,000 people in which the approved office must sit more than 1 mile from the border. While the franchisee is in compliance, the franchisor and affiliates will not operate or grant another ATC franchise at a location in the Territory, but the FDD states the territory is not exclusive.

brands.name: AtWork
brands.territoryDescription: The franchisee operates one Office in a Protected Territory of about 200,000 people, described by counties, streets, ZIP codes, or other boundaries. The territory is not exclusive, full-time placement rights inside it are non-exclusive, and the franchisor may reduce it if population grows by more than 50%.

brands.name: Auto-Lab
brands.territoryDescription: The franchise is for a specific approved location in a Designated Area, generally a minimum 2-mile radius. No other Auto-Lab Complete Car Care Center franchise store may be established in that area, but the franchisee does not receive an exclusive territory and marketing is not exclusive.

brands.name: barre3
brands.territoryDescription: The franchisee gets an authorized territory, usually at least a one-mile radius, inside which B3 will not place another studio. The FDD states the territory is not exclusive because B3 reserves internet, affiliate, and other-channel rights there.

brands.name: The Back Nine
brands.territoryDescription: Territory designation from Item 12: 'non-exclusive'.

brands.name: Basecamp Fitness
brands.territoryDescription: You do not receive an exclusive territory. After site approval the franchisor grants a protected territory, no larger than an area of 50,000 people, and will not operate or license another Basecamp studio physically inside it, except certain private-establishment studios.

brands.name: Bath Fitter
brands.territoryDescription: Territory designation from Item 12: 'non-exclusive'.

brands.name: Brain Balance
brands.territoryDescription: The franchisee receives an exclusive geographic area, set with the franchisor and often a radius around the Center, inside which the franchisor will not open or franchise another Brain Balance Center. The grant is conditioned on a minimum monthly royalty of at least $1,000 and later gross-sales thresholds of at least $400,000 per twelve-month period. Outside that Territory the franchise is non-exclusive.

brands.name: Beauty Bungalows
brands.territoryDescription: No exclusive territory is granted. After the site is secured, a Protected Territory is designated, typically a two-mile radius (or two blocks to two miles in a central business district), and the franchisor will not operate or grant another Beauty Bungalows outlet inside it. The FDD also states that Protected Territory and any Development Area are not exclusive.

brands.name: Bee Organized
brands.territoryDescription: Franchisee does not receive an exclusive territory and may face competition from other channels and brands the franchisor controls. While not in default, the franchisor will not open or grant another Bee Organized Business in the Operating Territory, subject to reserved rights. A territory is generally about 40,000 to 50,000 qualified households.

brands.name: beem Light Sauna
brands.territoryDescription: The franchise is for one accepted site inside a non-exclusive Site Selection Area. After the site is secured, the franchisee receives a protected Territory, typically about 50,000 people or a two-mile radius, whichever includes fewer people. The franchisor and affiliates will not open or license a Studio in that Territory except at Non-Traditional Locations, and the territory is not exclusive.

brands.name: RockBox Fitness
brands.territoryDescription: The Designated Territory is typically the lesser of about 50,000-150,000 people or a 3-mile radius, mapped by zip code. It is not exclusive. While the franchisee is in compliance, franchisor will not open another brick-and-mortar RockBox outlet in the territory or shrink it if population grows, but reserves alternate channels and other brands inside the territory.

brands.name: Better Homes and Gardens Real Estate
Dogtopia
brands.territoryDescription: No exclusive territory is granted. The franchisee receives a protected Territory: a 3-mile radius if fewer than 25,000 Core Profile Individuals live or work there, otherwise an area with at least 25,000. Other franchisees, company outlets, and other channels may compete.

brands.name: BFT
brands.territoryDescription: The franchisee does not receive an exclusive territory. After site acceptance, a Designated Territory (generally at least 15,000 people) is drawn, and while the franchisee is in compliance the franchisor will not operate or license another BFT Studio inside it, subject to reserved rights.

brands.name: Best In Class Education
brands.territoryDescription: Each franchise gets one approved site and a Center Territory of about 15,000 to 18,000 students ages 5 to 17. The territory is not exclusive, but during the term the franchisor will not open or license another Center there except for acquisitions and reserved alternative channels. An ADA grants a protected development territory.

brands.name: Big Blue Swim School
brands.territoryDescription: Franchisee receives an Area of Protection, expected to be about a 10-minute drive, with exclusive rights so no other BIG BLUE Swim School operating the Swim School Concept may be physically located there. Exclusivity does not depend on sales volume; the franchisor reserves other channels and non-concept locations inside the area.

brands.name: Bin Blasters
brands.territoryDescription: Franchisee receives a designated operating territory of about 30,000 to 50,000 households. It is not exclusive, but if the franchisee is not in default the franchisor will not open or grant another Bin Blasters business in that territory, subject to reserved rights including corporate accounts and other channels.

brands.name: Blue Moon Estate Sales
brands.territoryDescription: Territory designation from Item 12: 'protected'.

brands.name: Blue Nose
brands.territoryDescription: Franchisee receives an Operating Territory of about 250,000 people, mapped and mutually agreed. During the term the franchisor will not open or license another Franchised Business there, subject to stated exceptions including National Accounts, but the FDD says the territory is not exclusive.

brands.name: BNI
brands.territoryDescription: The franchisee may operate only inside an agreed Territory, generally zip codes covering at least 250,000 people, and may advertise and solicit members only there. The Territory is not exclusive, and the franchisor may compete through other franchisees, company outlets, and other channels.

brands.name: BOARD AND BRUSH CREATIVE STUDIO FRANCHISING
Boat Sitters
brands.territoryDescription: The franchisee is granted the right to develop and operate one Boat Sitters business in a designated operating territory. Territory size varies with local factors, market conditions, and territories purchased, and generally includes about 5,000 boat owners.

brands.name: Bosch Auto Service
brands.territoryDescription: Under the Franchise Agreement the Shop is at one approved Site and the franchisee receives no exclusive, protected, or other territorial rights and no minimum territory. A Development Rights Agreement can limit other Bosch shops inside the Development Area during that agreement’s term only.

brands.name: Black Optix Tint
brands.territoryDescription: The franchise is for a specific approved location and a Designated Territory (radius, zip codes, or other boundaries) in which the franchisor will not open or license another Black Optix Tint physical outlet during the term. The FDD states the franchisee will not receive an exclusive territory.

brands.name: Brightway Insurance
brands.territoryDescription: You may operate only at an approved premises and will not receive an exclusive territory. Other franchisees, company-owned outlets, and other channels may compete in the same area, and in-state solicitation of new customers is not territorially restricted.

brands.name: British Swim School
brands.territoryDescription: While the franchisee is in compliance, the franchisor will not operate or franchise another British Swim School in the Standard or Targeted Territory or allow another franchisee to use a pool in it. Each territory is identified in the agreement and has potential for at least two pools.

brands.name: Brooklyn Robot Foundry
brands.territoryDescription: Franchisee receives a Designated Territory of contiguous 5-digit ZIP codes with at least 5 elementary schools and 1 middle school. While in compliance, the franchisor will not open another franchised or company-owned Brooklyn Robot Foundry business there, but the FDD states the territory is not exclusive.

brands.name: Bubbly Laundry
brands.territoryDescription: One outlet in a territory defined by zip codes, block group, or a marked map, with a minimum population of 30,000. The franchisor will not establish a company-owned or franchised outlet selling the same or similar goods or services under the same or similar marks in that territory.

brands.name: Budget Rent A Car System, Inc
Building Kidz
brands.territoryDescription: The agreement grants a nonexclusive territory, generally at least a one-half-mile radius, in which the franchisor will not place another Building Kidz School except a National Account Location. It is geographic protection only and gives no exclusive right to customers in the territory.

brands.name: Buildingstars
brands.territoryDescription: You may clean only in the closest listed metro area or in New Jersey, and you need no business site. You do not receive an exclusive territory and may compete with other franchisees and franchisor outlets.

brands.name: Another Broken Egg Cafe
brands.territoryDescription: No exclusive territory. Franchisee may operate one Cafe in a Designated Trade Area, generally a one- to three-mile radius, where the franchisor will not open or authorize another system Cafe while the franchisee is in compliance. Many reserved rights remain, including non-traditional venues and alternate channels.

brands.name: Camp Bow Wow
brands.territoryDescription: You receive an Authorized Territory, and Camp Bow Wow will not place or license another Camp Bow Wow franchise inside it during the term. The territory is not exclusive; Camp Bow Wow reserves rights for other brands, channels, and internet sales inside it.

brands.name: Car-X
brands.territoryDescription: The franchise operates only from one approved location. No minimum or maximum territory is granted, and customers may be drawn from any area so long as services are provided from that location. Relocation requires Car-X approval.

brands.name: CareBuilders At Home
brands.territoryDescription: Franchisee receives a ZIP-code Designated Territory of about 30,000 to 40,000 people age 65 or older. While the franchisee is in compliance, the franchisor and affiliates will not operate or grant another CareBuilders At Home business in that territory, subject to stated exceptions and reserved rights.

brands.name: Carvel
brands.territoryDescription: The Shoppe may operate only at the Accepted Location, and you will not receive an exclusive territory. Co-branded Shoppes in streetside locations may receive a limited Area of Protection; other Shoppes receive no protected territory.

brands.name: Cascadia Pizza Co.
brands.territoryDescription: After site approval, the franchisor designates a territory, generally the smaller of five road miles or a population of 150,000. It is not exclusive, but while the franchisee is not in default the franchisor will not open or authorize another Cascadia Pizza Co. restaurant location in that territory, subject to broad reserved rights.

brands.name: CD ONE PRICE CLEANERS
brands.territoryDescription: The franchise is for one Site. The Protected Territory is exclusive (1/2-mile radius if urban, 1-mile if not). A larger ROFO Territory gives a right of first offer only. Other stores may still deliver into the territory, and marketing is not exclusive.

brands.name: Champions Martial Arts
brands.territoryDescription: The franchise agreement specifies only an approved site and does not grant a territory. The franchisee will not receive an exclusive territory and may face competition from other franchisees, franchisor outlets, and other channels. A multi-unit developer receives a Development Territory in which the franchisor will not open or license a center while the development schedule is met, but the FDD still states the developer will not receive an exclusive territory.

brands.name: Buona
brands.territoryDescription: For a single-brand Buona Business, the franchisee receives an exclusive Protected Area: a 1/2-mile radius from the approved location in an urban area, and otherwise an area with a minimum population of 60,000. The franchisor still reserves non-traditional sites inside that area and sales through alternative channels.

brands.name: Child’s Play Challenge Courses Franchising LLC
Children's Art Classes
brands.territoryDescription: The franchise agreement grants an exclusive territory of about 45,000 to 55,000 people, at least 15% children under 18, or a three-mile radius if not stated in writing within 90 days after opening. The franchisor will not open a company-owned or franchised Children's Art Classes outlet in that territory. A multi-unit development agreement does not grant an exclusive area-developer territory.

brands.name: Children's Orchard
brands.territoryDescription: Franchisee receives an exclusive Protected Area of a 2- to 6-mile radius, typically at least 50,000 people in metros over 200,000 or about 25,000 in smaller markets. No other Children's Orchard store may be established there while the franchisee is in compliance.

brands.name: CHISE DISCLOSURE DOCUMENT Coverall North America, Inc
Christian Brothers Automotive
brands.territoryDescription: You receive an exclusive geographic Territory and one site. CBAC will not operate or grant a similar or competitive franchise in that area. You may not operate outside the Territory, but you may solicit outside it if you do not solicit inside another franchisee’s territory.

brands.name: Christie's International Real Estate
brands.territoryDescription: The License Agreement may designate a Protected Territory, typically counties or zip codes, in which the franchisor will not open or license another Christie's office while the franchisee is in compliance. If none is designated, no territory is granted. Agents may still sell into a Protected Territory from offices outside it.

brands.name: CINCH I.T.
brands.territoryDescription: Franchisee receives a Designated Territory of about 3,000 to 3,500 qualified businesses (10 or more employees). While the agreement is in effect and the franchisee is not in default, the franchisor will not establish or license another CINCH I.T. business there, but the FDD states the franchisee will not receive an exclusive territory.

brands.name: City Wide
brands.territoryDescription: Franchisee is granted a protected Designated Territory for commercial janitorial and related facility services and must operate from an office inside that territory.

brands.name: City2Shore
brands.territoryDescription: You may operate one outlet in a territory defined after site approval. While you meet minimum agent requirements, the franchisor will not place another City2Shore business there, but the territory is not exclusive and others may advertise and sell inside it.

brands.name: Class 101
brands.territoryDescription: The franchisee does not receive an exclusive territory and operates at an approved location inside a Protected Area set by zip code, boundary, or radius, with no minimum size. While the franchisee is in compliance, the franchisor will not operate or grant another Class 101 business in that Protected Area, except for reserved rights.

brands.name: Cleanest Restaurant Group
brands.territoryDescription: Franchisee gets a designated operating territory of about 300,000 people. It is not exclusive, but if the franchisee is not in default the franchisor will not open or authorize another Cleanest Restaurant Group outlet there, while reserving corporate accounts and other channels.

brands.name: Clearview Insurance
brands.territoryDescription: The franchisee may operate from a home office or an office but is not granted territory rights or any exclusive or protected territory. The franchisee may face competition from other franchisees, franchisor-owned businesses, or other channels, and agencies must not knowingly solicit another Clearview Insurance Agency's clients.

brands.name: Cloud 9 Foot Spa
brands.territoryDescription: One Cloud 9 Foot Spa in a limited protected territory set after site approval, generally at least 30,000 people who live or work nearby. While the franchisee is not in default, the franchisor will not open or authorize another dedicated outlet in that territory. The territory is not exclusive, and captive-market sites receive no protected territory.

brands.name: CKO Kickboxing
brands.territoryDescription: The franchise agreement grants an exclusive territory of about 50,000 people or a 5-mile radius, whichever is less, drawn by zip codes, county lines, or streets. The franchisor will not open or allow another franchisee to open a Facility inside that territory.

brands.name: Club Pilates
brands.territoryDescription: You will not receive an exclusive territory. After the site is accepted, a Designated Territory (generally at least 15,000 people) is set, and while you are in compliance the franchisor will not operate or license another Club Pilates Studio inside it, subject to reserved rights.

brands.name: Club SciKidz
brands.territoryDescription: The Franchise Agreement grants a mutually agreed Designated Territory of whole contiguous counties and/or zip codes with a population of 450,000 to 1,000,000. It is exclusive: Club SciKidz will not operate or license elementary-school-level science programs or after-school science programs there under the Club SciKidz brand or similar marks. Missing minimum program targets can alter the territory or remove exclusivity.

brands.name: Club Z!
brands.territoryDescription: The franchise is a protected territory of 50,000 to not more than 200,000 population. While the franchisee is in compliance, the franchisor will not grant or operate a Club Z business in that territory, but the franchisee does not receive an exclusive territory.

brands.name: CMIT Solutions
brands.territoryDescription: The franchise grants an exclusive Territory, usually by ZIP code, with about 3,000 to 4,500 eligible small-business establishments (typical about 3,500). Exclusivity bars other CMIT premises in the Territory; outlets outside it may still serve customers inside it.

brands.name: Card My Yard
brands.territoryDescription: Franchisee does not receive an exclusive territory. After a home or approved site is set, franchisor grants a Protected Area defined by zip codes, typically contiguous and at least 30,000 population. While the franchisee complies, franchisor and affiliates will not establish or authorize another Card My Yard business in that Protected Area.

brands.name: Fundraising University
brands.territoryDescription: The franchise agreement specifies a contiguous territory of about 50,000 high school students, based on enrollment at signing. The franchise is expected to be managed from a home inside the territory unless the franchisor approves otherwise.

brands.name: Code Wiz
brands.territoryDescription: The franchisee does not receive an exclusive territory. After site approval, the franchisor designates an area, generally the smaller of a 5-mile radius or a population of 15,000 people ages 5-18, and will not open or authorize another Code Wiz Retail Learning Center there during the term if the franchisee is not in default, subject to reserved rights.

brands.name: Color Me Mine
brands.territoryDescription: Franchise is for one approved location plus a Protected Territory, generally at least 250,000 people. The franchisor will not place another Color Me Mine outlet in that territory, except Non-Traditional locations, and states the territory is not exclusive.

brands.name: Freeway Insurance
brands.territoryDescription: No exclusive territory is granted. While the franchisee is not in default, the franchisor will not license another Freeway Brokerage inside the Protected Area; size is discretionary and there is no minimum area.

brands.name: Conquer Ninja
brands.territoryDescription: Franchisee receives one gym and a Designated Territory, generally a 10-, 3-, or 1-mile radius by metro population. While in compliance, the franchisor will not operate or grant another Conquer Ninja obstacle-course gym in that territory, but the FDD states the franchisee will not receive an exclusive territory.

brands.name: Cookie Advantage
brands.territoryDescription: The franchise grants a protected territory sized by geography and population, with a stated effort to grant only one franchise per area of up to 1.5 million people. It is not exclusive: the franchisor will not place another principal place of business in the territory but reserves national accounts, the Internet, and other channels.

brands.name: Cool Binz
brands.territoryDescription: Territory is specific zip codes of about 350,000 to 450,000 people, up to 500,000. It is not exclusive. No other COOL BINZ office or specified local advertising may be placed in the Territory, but other outlets may service customers there without compensation.

brands.name: Corporate Cleaning Group
brands.territoryDescription: The franchise grants an exclusive territory, shown by zip codes or other boundaries and sized using up to 400 niche prospects. While the franchisee is not in default, the franchisor will not open or authorize another Corporate Cleaning Group outlet in the territory, but reserves alternative channels and national accounts.

brands.name: CorporateConnections
brands.territoryDescription: Franchisee may operate only inside a defined Region and must reside there, but the Region is not exclusive. Franchisees may face competition from other franchisees, franchisor outlets, other channels, and BNI.

brands.name: Costa Oil
brands.territoryDescription: The franchise grants an exclusive Marketing Area, generally about 50,000 people or a 3-mile radius, in which the franchisor will not open a company-owned or franchised Costa Oil outlet. Exclusivity is not tied to sales volume; the franchisor may still solicit inside the area through other channels.

brands.name: Créatif
brands.territoryDescription: One outlet in a territory of contiguous ZIP codes set after site approval, with a minimum population of 80,000 or a 5-mile radius. While not in default, no other Créatif outlet will be opened in the territory, but the grant is not exclusive and alternative channels are reserved.

brands.name: Crestcom
brands.territoryDescription: The franchisee markets within an Assigned Area, usually part of a state, but does not receive an exclusive territory and may face competition from other franchisees, franchisor outlets, and other channels. After the Threshold Number of Qualifying Businesses is reached, the franchisor refrains from adding outlets until the count falls below that number; optional Principal Marketing Areas are limited and semi-exclusive but still not exclusive.

brands.name: Crumbl
brands.territoryDescription: The franchisee may use the system and marks only at an approved site inside a negotiated area, generally about 1 to 2 miles from the premises. The FDD states the franchisee will not receive an exclusive territory and may face competition from other franchisees, franchisor outlets, and other channels.

brands.name: CyberGlobal
brands.territoryDescription: Territory is set from geography, population, and demographics, and the franchisor will use commercially reasonable efforts to grant only one franchise in an area with at least 5,000 businesses with over 20 employees. The franchisee does not receive an exclusive territory and may face competition from other franchisees, company outlets, and other channels, including National Accounts.

brands.name: CycleBar
brands.territoryDescription: You will not receive an exclusive territory. After site acceptance, a Designated Territory, generally at least 15,000 people, gives protected rights: while you are in compliance, the franchisor will not operate or license another CycleBar Studio inside it, subject to reserved rights.

brands.name: D1
brands.territoryDescription: You do not receive an exclusive territory. After site approval you receive a designated territory, generally a 0.20- to 3-mile radius, where the franchisor will not open or license another permanent D1 facility, but the territory is non-exclusive and may overlap.

brands.name: David Grossman at Renue Systems Development Corp
Drybar
brands.territoryDescription: You will not receive an exclusive territory. While you are in compliance, the franchisor will not own, operate, or authorize other Shops in a Protected Area, typically a 1.5-mile radius (or, in dense urban areas, the lesser of 1.5 miles or a 50,000-person radius). The Search Territory is non-exclusive and only for site selection.

brands.name: DDSmatch
brands.territoryDescription: Territory designation from Item 12: 'exclusive'.

brands.name: DEA Music & Art
brands.territoryDescription: The franchisee receives an exclusive territory centered on the approved location, generally a circle with a 3-mile radius or up to 200,000 population, whichever is less. The franchisor may not open or authorize another DEA Music & Art business at a physical location inside the territory, but reserves rights outside the territory, for alternative marks, and for other channels including the Internet.

brands.name: Decimal
brands.territoryDescription: After site acceptance, a Territory is defined by map boundaries and/or zip codes with a minimum population of 100,000. The franchisee does not receive an exclusive territory and may face competition inside it, but if in compliance neither the franchisor nor its affiliates will operate or authorize another Decimal Business whose physical premises are in the Territory.

brands.name: Del Taco
brands.territoryDescription: The franchisee does not receive an exclusive territory. Del Taco grants a protected one-mile radius from the restaurant front door, excluding alternative points of distribution, and will not operate or license another Del Taco at a physical premises in that area during the term, subject to stated reservations.

brands.name: Vanguard Cleaning Systems
brands.territoryDescription: No exclusive territory is granted. The franchisee is licensed to operate in the franchisor's Maryland and Delaware development area, where other franchises may be granted, and accounts are generally in the selected county and about a 15-mile radius of each other.

brands.name: Dentsmart
brands.territoryDescription: Franchisee receives a protected Territory, typically counties, states, or portions of states. Franchisor will not open or license another Dentsmart business there, but states the territory is not exclusive and reserves Key Accounts, weather-event management, advertising, and other channels.

brands.name: Detail Garage
brands.territoryDescription: A franchisee in good standing may receive a non-exclusive protected radius of up to 5 miles, or less than 1 mile in a dense downtown area. The franchisor and affiliates will not open or authorize another Detail Garage store inside that radius, but the franchisee does not receive an exclusive territory.

brands.name: Dippin' Dots
brands.territoryDescription: You will not receive an exclusive territory. Rights inside a mutually agreed territory depend on the Territory, Store Only, or Distribution model, and the franchisor may sell in or reduce the territory if performance requirements are missed.

brands.name: Discover Strength
brands.territoryDescription: Franchisee receives a Protected Territory, generally the lesser of a 3-mile radius or an area with about 50,000 people. While the franchisee complies, the franchisor will not establish another franchised or company-owned Discover Strength business in that territory. The franchisee does not receive an exclusive territory.

brands.name: Discovery Map
brands.territoryDescription: You receive a limited exclusive Area of Exclusive Rights, typically at least 400 businesses, and DMI will not grant another DISCOVERY MAP franchise in that Area. Minimum annual sales of $20,000, $30,000, then $40,000 apply, and national-account and other-channel rights are reserved.

brands.name: Deka Lash
brands.territoryDescription: Each studio gets a Protected Area, generally a 1.5-mile radius, that is an exclusive territory where the franchisor will not establish a company-owned or franchised outlet selling the same or similar goods under the same or similar marks. The territory is not exclusive for marketing.

brands.name: Driverseat
brands.territoryDescription: The franchise grants a protected geographic territory sized from population and demographics tied to the initial fee level. It is not exclusive; other franchisees, company outlets, app bookings, and commercial clients may compete inside it.

brands.name: Driving Academy
brands.territoryDescription: Franchisee does not receive an exclusive territory but is awarded a protected territory of up to 15 miles driven in any direction from the accepted site. During the term the franchisor will not open or authorize another Driving Academy business inside that territory.

brands.name: DryJect
brands.territoryDescription: Franchisee operates only in an approved designated territory sized to cover at least the equivalent of 200 eighteen-hole golf courses. If the franchisee stays in compliance, the franchisor will not operate or grant a similar franchise under the Marks in that territory, but the FDD states the franchisee will not receive an exclusive territory.

brands.name: DumpStor
brands.territoryDescription: Franchisee receives a protected Territory, generally zip-code based and up to about 350,000 people, in which the franchisor will not operate or authorize others to operate under the Marks, subject to retained rights. The FDD states the franchisee will not receive an exclusive territory.

brands.name: DVMmatch
brands.territoryDescription: Franchisee receives an exclusive territory of counties agreed at signing. Continued exclusivity depends only on remaining in good standing; the franchisor will not modify the territory unless the franchisee is in default.

brands.name: United Defense Tactical
brands.territoryDescription: After site approval, the franchisor designates a territory, generally the lesser of five road miles or about 150,000 households, and will not itself open or authorize another United Defense Tactical Center location inside it while the franchisee is not in default, subject to reserved rights including captive markets and other sales channels.

brands.name: Earl of Sandwich
brands.territoryDescription: The Franchise Agreement grants a Protected Area around the approved site in which the franchisor will not operate or license other Earl of Sandwich restaurants while the franchisee is in compliance, with reservations including nontraditional locations and other channels. A Development Agreement does not grant an exclusive territory.

brands.name: ecomaids
brands.territoryDescription: The Agreement identifies a Territory of at least 25,000 single-family residences. If the franchisee is in compliance, EM will not operate or grant an ecomaids Business whose territory overlaps the Territory in any material respect, but the FDD states the franchisee will not receive an exclusive territory and EM reserves other channels, brands, and competitive rights.

brands.name: Elements Massage
brands.territoryDescription: The franchisee does not receive an exclusive territory and may compete with other franchisees, franchisor outlets, and other channels. If in compliance, the franchisor will not own, operate, or authorize Studios in a Protected Area, typically a 1.5-mile radius around the Studio (sometimes a smaller urban boundary).

brands.name: EMS To You
brands.territoryDescription: The franchisee receives a Protected Territory of about 110,000 households, set by county, city, ZIP codes, streets, or other boundaries. While the franchisee is in compliance, the franchisor will not operate or grant an EMS To You franchise inside it, but the FDD states the franchisee will not receive an exclusive territory.

brands.name: Engel & Völkers
brands.territoryDescription: Franchisee operates one approved location in a zip-code Protected Area. Franchisor will not open or grant another Engel & Völkers residential brokerage there, but franchisor and other franchisees may still solicit, market, and close residential transactions inside that area.

brands.name: EOS Worldwide
brands.territoryDescription: The franchisee does not receive an exclusive or protected territory and may offer products and services anywhere in the world, subject to law, sanctions, and the franchisor’s reserved channels and rights.

brands.name: GlobalGreen Insurance Agency
brands.territoryDescription: The franchisee may operate one agency at an approved site and does not receive an exclusive territory. The franchisee, GLOBAL, affiliates, and other franchisees may solicit anywhere they are licensed and approved by Providers.

brands.name: Estrella Insurance
brands.territoryDescription: For a commercial office in compliance, the franchisor will not grant or operate another commercial office within one driving mile of the location. The FDD calls this a protected territory and states the franchisee does not receive an exclusive territory; home-based locations may be placed inside it.

brands.name: EverLine Coatings and Services
brands.territoryDescription: A typical Designated Territory has about 350,000 people. Franchisor will not open or license another System outlet in that territory while rights continue, but the franchisee does not receive an exclusive territory and franchisor reserves multi-state or multi-territory client accounts.

brands.name: The Exercise Coach
brands.territoryDescription: The franchise grants the right to operate one Studio at an approved site in a territory of at least 5,000 qualified households (annual household income of at least $120,000). During the term the franchisor will not open or license another Studio using the Marks in that territory.

brands.name: Express Oil Change
brands.territoryDescription: The franchise is for one specified Center. If the franchisee is not in default, the franchisor will not operate or grant another Center within 1 mile (the Protected Area), which the FDD also calls exclusive. An area-development agreement can add an exclusive Development Area. Tuffy/TAC outlets may still operate inside the Protected Area.

brands.name: Office Pride
brands.territoryDescription: The franchisee does not receive an exclusive territory. Operations are limited to a defined area, typically counties, ZIP codes, and/or a metro area covering about 15,000 to 25,000 businesses, and the business address must be inside that territory.

brands.name: Fantastic Sams
brands.territoryDescription: You will not receive an exclusive territory. After site approval, the franchisor designates a limited Protected Area, usually a half-mile radius, and will not open or allow another franchisee to open a Salon inside it. Dessange salons may be located in that area.

brands.name: FASTSIGNS
brands.territoryDescription: The franchisee may operate one Center at an approved site in a Territory generally covering at least 4,000 businesses. The franchisor will not open or authorize another Center in that Territory unless businesses increase by at least 20%, but neither the franchisor nor other franchisees are barred from soliciting inside it.

brands.name: FIRE Fitness Camp
brands.territoryDescription: The franchisee does not receive an exclusive territory. While in compliance, the franchisee receives a Protected Territory in which the franchisor and its affiliates will not open or authorize another FIRE Fitness Camp. Size is negotiated from a street address up to a defined area and has no minimum geographic size.

brands.name: Fish Window Cleaning
brands.territoryDescription: The franchisee operates in a geographic Territory described in Schedule A. Packages are approximately 75,000 persons (Small), 200,000 (Standard), or 400,000 (Executive). The supplied text does not state whether the territory is exclusive.

brands.name: Fit Body Boot Camp
brands.territoryDescription: No territory for the virtual business. For the physical outlet, if the franchisee is not in uncured default, the franchisor will not place another physical Fit Body outlet in a designated territory, typically 1/4 mile to 3 miles around the outlet. The FDD states the franchise is not exclusive.

brands.name: Farrell's Extreme Bodyshaping
brands.territoryDescription: After site approval, the franchisor grants an Approved Territory, typically about a two-mile driveable distance, and will not place another FARRELL'S Studio there except Special Venues. The FDD states the franchise is non-exclusive and is not an exclusive territory.

brands.name: Fitness Factory
brands.territoryDescription: The franchisee receives a Territory around one Authorized Location that gives geographic protection from other Fitness Factory franchise or company outlets inside its boundaries, but the FDD states the franchisee will not receive an exclusive territory and may face competition from other channels and brands the franchisor controls. A typical territory is about 50,000 to 75,000 people, delineated by ZIP codes.

brands.name: Fitness Together
brands.territoryDescription: You will not receive an exclusive territory. You may only search for a site inside a non-exclusive Search Territory. If you stay in compliance, the franchisor will not own, operate, or authorize Fitness Together Studios in your Protected Area, typically a 1.5-mile radius around the Studio.

brands.name: Flour Power
brands.territoryDescription: After site approval, the franchisor designates a territory, generally the smaller of four road miles from the studio or an area with 12,000 children ages 14 and under. The franchisee does not receive an exclusive territory, but during the term the franchisor will not open or authorize another Flour Power Studio location inside that territory, subject to reserved rights including other channels and captive markets.

brands.name: Flurry Fitness
brands.territoryDescription: The franchisee does not receive an exclusive territory. After site approval, the franchisee receives a protected territory of at least a 4-mile radius in which the franchisor will not open or license another Flurry Fitness facility, except for permitted acquisitions.

brands.name: Fly Alliance
brands.territoryDescription: Territory designation from Item 12: 'non-exclusive'.

brands.name: Fly Dance Fitness
brands.territoryDescription: After the approved location is secured, franchisee receives an exclusive territory of at least 50,000 people. Franchisor will not operate or grant a similar Fly Dance Fitness studio in that territory. Exclusivity is not contingent on sales, and other-channel sales into the territory are reserved.

brands.name: Kwik Kopy
brands.territoryDescription: You receive a principal business area of one or more ZIP codes, not an exclusive territory. For five years after the center opens, Fortusis will not develop another same-trademark franchise or similar channel in that area; after that, additional centers are offered first by seniority.

brands.name: Fitness Premier
brands.territoryDescription: After site approval, the designated territory is generally the smaller of 2.5 road miles from the club or a 50,000-person area. The franchisor will not open or authorize another Fitness Premier club in that territory while the franchisee is not in default, subject to broad reserved rights, and states the franchisee does not receive an exclusive territory.

brands.name: Franchise Development Director at Snap Fitness, Inc
FRANCHISE DISCLOSURE DOCUMENT ASI Sign Systems, Inc
GYMGUYZ
brands.territoryDescription: You receive a designated protected territory, typically 30,000 households. During the term the franchisor will not operate or grant another GYMGUYZ franchise in that territory, subject to reserved rights, and the FDD states you will not receive an exclusive territory.

brands.name: ZAGG
brands.territoryDescription: Exclusive territory is the shopping mall or retail center where the outlet is located, or a defined area if it is not in a mall. Franchisor will not open another franchised business there without consent, but reserves non-franchised distribution channels inside the territory.

brands.name: FRANCHISE DISCLOSURE DOCUMENT Modo Yoga International, Inc
N Zone Sports
brands.territoryDescription: Franchisee may develop and operate in a designated territory, generally about 150,000 or 300,000 people. If the franchisee is not in default, the franchisor will not open or authorize another N ZONE SPORTS outlet in that operating territory, but the FDD states the franchisee will not receive an exclusive territory.

brands.name: Novus Global
brands.territoryDescription: The franchisee does not receive an exclusive, non-exclusive, or protected territory, and the franchise is not tied to a specific location. The franchisee may face competition from other franchisees, franchisor outlets, and other channels of distribution.

brands.name: Frank & Furter's
brands.territoryDescription: The franchisee may operate one restaurant at a specified premises inside a Protected Area, generally a 1/2-to-1-mile radius, where the franchisor will not open or license another restaurant while the franchisee is in compliance. The FDD states the franchisee will not receive an exclusive territory, and special locations and other channels may compete inside the area.

brands.name: Fleet Clean
brands.territoryDescription: The territory is defined before signing and is at least about one county. It is not exclusive, but while the franchisee is in compliance the franchisor and affiliates will not provide Core Services under the Marks in the territory or license a third party to do so, subject to stated exceptions.

brands.name: G-FORCE
brands.territoryDescription: The franchisee does not receive an exclusive territory. While not in default, the franchisor and affiliates will not establish or franchise another G-FORCE Business in the Operating Territory, subject to reserved rights including National Accounts. A standard territory covers about 3,000,000 people.

brands.name: Sport Clips
brands.territoryDescription: Each agreement is for one approved location. During the initial 5-year term the territory is exclusive and is the lesser of a 1-mile radius or a radius covering 25,000 people. After that term there is no exclusive territory, only a 30-day first right of refusal if the franchisee is not in default.

brands.name: Mulberrys Garment Care
brands.territoryDescription: No exclusive territory. A Designated Area is for site selection only. After site acceptance, a Protected Area (about a 2-mile radius, metes and bounds, or zip codes) bars the franchisor from operating or licensing other Mulberrys outlets there, with broad reserved rights.

brands.name: Genius Kids
brands.territoryDescription: After site approval, the franchisee receives a limited protected territory, generally a 2-mile radius around the Center not beyond city limits. The franchisor will not locate or authorize another Genius Kids child learning center in that territory while the franchisee is in compliance, but the territory is not exclusive and may overlap.

brands.name: Pinot's Palette
brands.territoryDescription: The franchisee does not receive an exclusive territory. The agreement may grant a protected territory, generally a diameter of miles around the approved site or defined by ZIP codes or boundaries, in which the franchisor will not open or license another Pinot’s Palette during the term.

brands.name: Tuffy
brands.territoryDescription: The franchise is limited to an approved site and is not an exclusive territory. A protected area, generally a three-mile radius excluding existing or in-development centers, bars other Tuffy-trademark locations but not marketing to customers in that area from outside locations.

brands.name: GLO Tanning
brands.territoryDescription: The franchisee receives an exclusive territory in which the franchisor will not establish another franchise, affiliate, or company-owned GLO Tanning unit while the franchisee is in strict compliance. Territory size is usually 2 miles from the location, or the facility boundaries if the salon is in a mall or similar captive market.

brands.name: GLO30
brands.territoryDescription: One outlet in a territory drawn after site approval. It is not exclusive, but while the franchisee is not in default the franchisor will not open or authorize another GLO30 outlet in the territory. Alternative channels and non-traditional sites are reserved.

brands.name: Global Art
brands.territoryDescription: You will not receive an exclusive territory. You get a protected territory of up to 2 driven miles in any direction, not past city limits, and during the term the franchisor will not place a company-owned or other Global Art franchise inside it, while reserving other sales channels.

brands.name: Global Recruiters Network
brands.territoryDescription: The franchisee receives no exclusive or protected territory around the accepted business location. Rights are non-exclusive, and any GRN business may solicit clients and candidates and advertise anywhere.

brands.name: Go Greek Yogurt
brands.territoryDescription: The franchisee does not receive an exclusive territory. The franchisor grants a Protected Area equal to a 2-mile radius around the shop (or the captive-venue premises only) and, if the franchisee is not in default, will not operate or license another Go Greek Shop or ghost kitchen in that area, subject to captive-venue and acquisition exceptions.

brands.name: Gold's Gym
brands.territoryDescription: Territory designation from Item 12: 'non-exclusive'.

brands.name: Gotcha Covered
brands.territoryDescription: No exclusive territory is granted. The franchisee receives an Area of Primary Responsibility of at least 30,000 households, but may sell anywhere, and the franchisor and other franchisees may sell inside that area. Active promotion outside the area requires written approval.

brands.name: Granite Garage Floors
brands.territoryDescription: Franchisor designates a territory, typically a radius, zip codes, counties, or a metro area, with a minimum of 250,000 households. It will not operate or franchise a Granite Garage Floors outlet physically located in the territory, but the franchisee does not receive an exclusive territory and other channels and brands are reserved.

brands.name: Grease Monkey
brands.territoryDescription: A Designated Area is used only to pick a site and gives no exclusive or other territorial rights. You operate at one Franchised Location and may face competition from other franchisees, franchisor or affiliate outlets, and SpeeDee and Kwik Kar.

brands.name: Green Food Solutions
brands.territoryDescription: One Operating Territory, generally 275,000 to 350,000 people, is granted. It is not exclusive, but if the franchisee is not in default the franchisor will not open or authorize another Green Food Solutions business there, subject to reserved rights including alternate channels and corporate accounts.

brands.name: Green Motion Car and Van Rental
brands.territoryDescription: The territory is agreed before signing and is not exclusive. If the franchisee is not in default, the franchisor will not open or authorize another outlet in the territory using the same marks, while reserving other brands, channels, and commercial accounts.

brands.name: Griffin Waste Services
brands.territoryDescription: At least one exclusive zip-code territory of about 500,000 people. If the franchisee is not in breach, the franchisor will not open a competing company-owned or franchised outlet under the Marks in the Territory. Exclusivity requires $300,000 gross revenue in year one and at least 5% growth in year two.

brands.name: Gym Skills
brands.territoryDescription: Single-unit territory is a circle centered on the approved location with a diameter of 3 miles or 100,000 people, whichever is less (metro diameter set by franchisor). Franchisor will not open or grant another Gym Skills Business at a physical location in the territory, but reserves internet, non-traditional sites, and outlets outside the territory.

brands.name: Honest1
brands.territoryDescription: You receive an exclusive territory, standardly a 3-mile radius that franchisor may set smaller or irregular before the site is approved. After it is set, franchisor will not open or franchise another Honest1 Center in it and will not solicit inside it; customers from outside may still be served.

brands.name: Hand and Stone Massage and Facial Spa
brands.territoryDescription: A Protected Territory is set in the franchisor's discretion, generally not over a 3-mile radius or 50,000 residents. While the franchisee is in compliance, no other Hand and Stone franchise will be established in it, but the territory is not exclusive and may be redefined.

brands.name: Harcourts
brands.territoryDescription: Franchisee receives an exclusive zip-code territory and a map of the zip codes where the office may operate. Exclusivity can be removed, or the agreement terminated, if the Key Performance Indicator is missed for three consecutive months or any three months in twelve. Other Harcourts agents may list or sell specific properties in the territory but may not locate an office there.

brands.name: Kids Garden
brands.territoryDescription: The franchisee may operate only at the approved location and, except in high-density metro or non-traditional sites, receives a territory (typically a five-mile radius) in which the franchisor will not establish or franchise another Kids Garden during the term.

brands.name: Haven
brands.territoryDescription: The franchisee operates at one approved site and receives an exclusive Area of Protection. There is no minimum or maximum size; contours depend on the market and may follow zip codes, geography, roads, boundaries, or drive-times, and may be changed during the term only if the Club relocates.

brands.name: Heaven's Best
brands.territoryDescription: The franchisor grants a defined Franchise Territory, typically about 150,000 to 200,000 persons. It is protected for residential and commercial carpet, flooring, and upholstery cleaning so the franchisor will not establish or allow another Heaven's Best business there without permission while the agreement is in force and the franchisee is not in material default, but the territory is not exclusive.

brands.name: Heavyweight Waste
brands.territoryDescription: The franchisor approves a Territory, usually set by geographic boundaries and zip-code population, generally a minimum of about 200,000. The franchisee does not receive an exclusive territory and may face competition from other franchisees, franchisor-owned outlets, and other channels.

brands.name: Hello Sugar
brands.territoryDescription: One outlet in a territory set after site approval, at least the lesser of 60,000 people or a 2-mile radius. The territory is not exclusive, but while the franchisee is not in default the franchisor will not open or authorize another Hello Sugar outlet there.

brands.name: HERLIFE Magazine
brands.territoryDescription: The franchisee receives an exclusive territory of about 250,000 to 750,000 people, defined by contiguous ZIP codes, county or other boundaries, or a map. Exclusivity continues only if minimum monthly sales are met, and the franchisor reserves alternative-channel and out-of-territory rights.

brands.name: HEYDAY
brands.territoryDescription: The Shop operates at one accepted site inside a non-exclusive Development Area and receives an Area of Protection, expected to be about a 10-minute drive. The franchisor will not locate another HEYDAY Shop in that area except at Non-Traditional Venues, and the FDD states the franchisee does not receive an exclusive territory.

brands.name: Kitchen Tune-Up
brands.territoryDescription: No exclusive territory. Franchisor grants a protected ZIP-code territory starting at about 41,000 households and will not establish another franchised Kitchen Improvements business using the System and Marks in that territory.

brands.name: HHO Carbon Clean Systems
brands.territoryDescription: One operating territory, generally about 250,000 people. The FDD states the territory is not exclusive, but while the franchisee is not in default the franchisor will not open or grant another HHO Carbon Clean Systems business in it, subject to reserved rights including alternate channels and corporate accounts.

brands.name: Mellow Mushroom
brands.territoryDescription: The franchise grants an exclusive territory equal to a 3-mile radius from the restaurant’s front entrance, within which the franchisor will not locate or allow another franchisee to locate another Mellow Mushroom restaurant.

brands.name: HomeSmart
brands.territoryDescription: A negotiated territory is granted for the central office and any branch offices. If the franchisee is in compliance and meets the Annual Agent Quota, the franchisor will not open a competing HomeSmart brokerage in the territory, but the franchisee does not receive an exclusive territory and others may list and sell there.

brands.name: HomeWell Care Services
brands.territoryDescription: The franchisee does not receive an exclusive territory. The territory is contiguous ZIP codes with 30,000 to 40,000 seniors age 65+ (total population not over 350,000), and HomeWell will not operate or authorize another HomeWell Care Services business serving clients in that territory except refused or unserviced referred leads.

brands.name: Honest Art
brands.territoryDescription: One studio in a territory of contiguous ZIP codes covering all or part of a town, city, or county, with at least 20,000 households. It is not exclusive, but while the franchisee is not in default the franchisor will not open or authorize another Honest Art studio outlet in the territory.

brands.name: Honest
brands.territoryDescription: The franchisee does not receive an exclusive territory. A traditional site gets a circle of 1/2 mile if urban, 3 miles if suburban, or 5 miles otherwise, inside which the franchisor will not operate or franchise the same type of Honest Restaurant, subject to stated exceptions. Nontraditional sites receive no territory.

brands.name: HOODZ
brands.territoryDescription: The franchisee is awarded a geographic Territory in which to advertise, solicit, and perform services under stated conditions. Other franchisees and Company Stores may also solicit and perform exhaust-hood, oven-cleaning, and related services in that Territory.

brands.name: Hot Ground Gym
brands.territoryDescription: You do not receive an exclusive territory. While in compliance you receive a Protected Territory, with no minimum size, in which the franchisor and affiliates will not open or authorize another Hot Ground Gym location; other solicitation and reserved distribution rights remain.

brands.name: Hott Blow Dry and Beauty Lounge
brands.territoryDescription: No exclusive territory. Site search is in a non-exclusive Search Territory. If the franchisee stays in compliance, the franchisor will not own, operate, or authorize other Hott Salons in a Protected Area, typically about 50,000 living and working population, with captive-market and other-brand exceptions.

brands.name: House of Colour
brands.territoryDescription: The franchise grants a protected territory sized using geography and about 100,000 population. While the franchisee complies and meets performance criteria, the franchisor will not locate another House of Colour Business in the territory. The territory is not exclusive.

brands.name: MRINetwork
brands.territoryDescription: The franchise is a single-site non-exclusive location with no minimum territorial rights. The franchisee may solicit anywhere in the world, and MRI may sell additional franchises in the same area and need not compensate the franchisee.

brands.name: HRBoost
brands.territoryDescription: You will not receive an exclusive territory and may face competition from other franchisees, franchisor outlets, and other channels. The franchisor may restrict marketing and solicitation, including to certain zip codes, and a prospect right arises only after a 15-minute meeting and lasts six months.

brands.name: Hudson Valley Swim
brands.territoryDescription: After a pool is approved, the franchisor will not operate or grant another Hudson Valley Swim business in the territory while the franchisee is in compliance. The territory is typically zip codes with about 36,000 to 44,000 children. The FDD states the franchisee will not receive an exclusive territory.

brands.name: Hydralive
brands.territoryDescription: Franchisee receives a Protected Territory equal to the lesser of a 75,000-person area or a 3-mile radius. The franchisor will not franchise or open another Hydralive clinic inside it during the term, but states the territory is not exclusive.

brands.name: i4 Search Group
brands.territoryDescription: Franchisee receives a designated operating territory sized by population tier, but the FDD states it is not exclusive. While the franchisee is not in default, the franchisor will not open or grant another i4 Business in that territory, subject to broad reserved rights including other specialty lines, alternative channels, and corporate accounts.

brands.name: Intelligent Assistant
brands.territoryDescription: Territory designation from Item 12: 'protected'.

brands.name: Ideal Automotive Services
brands.territoryDescription: Franchisee gets a limited protected territory, not an exclusive one, set after site approval by map or contiguous ZIP codes (as small as a 10-block urban radius or a 3-mile suburban radius). While not in default, no other dedicated Ideal Automotive Services outlet may open in the territory; non-traditional venues and other channels are reserved.

brands.name: Ike's Love & Sandwiches
brands.territoryDescription: Franchisees are granted a Designated Territory with a minimum radius of 1/4 mile (urban) or 2 miles (suburban), but do not receive an exclusive territory and may face competition from other franchisees, company-owned outlets, or alternate distribution channels.

brands.name: Image One
brands.territoryDescription: The franchisee receives a protected but not exclusive territory of at least 5,000 businesses. While the franchisee is in compliance, Image One will not operate or grant another Image One business located in that territory, but other franchisees may serve referral or pre-existing clients inside it.

brands.name: Image Studios
brands.territoryDescription: No exclusive territory. After the location is approved, the lease is signed, and the franchise agreement is signed, franchisee receives a protected radius of one-half mile, one mile, or two miles around the unit, chosen by the franchisor.

brands.name: Indy Clover
