brands.territoryDescription: Franchisees receive a protected territory defined by a radius (generally 3 miles) with a minimum population of 60,000 for Fitness Studios or 30,000 for Personal Training Studios, but it is not exclusive.

brands.name: The Yard Gym
brands.territoryDescription: The franchisor assigns a Territory (minimum one zip code) where neither the franchisor nor affiliates will establish or issue franchise rights to others, subject to reserved rights for nontraditional venues and chain acquisitions.

brands.name: theCoderSchool
brands.territoryDescription: Franchisees are granted a protected territory of an approximate 5-mile radius around the school location, within which the franchisor will not establish or license another theCoderSchool business, subject to overlap adjustments and consent requirements.

brands.name: Tide Cleaners
brands.territoryDescription: The territory is determined by the franchisor based on factors like population density and competition, typically covering an approximate six-minute drive time from the outlet. While the franchisor will not operate or grant another franchise within this territory, the franchisee does not receive an exclusive territory and may face competition from other channels.

brands.name: Tierra Encantada
brands.territoryDescription: Franchisees receive a protected territory generally containing a population of 50,000 or more, but it is not exclusive; franchisor retains rights to operate or license others outside the territory and may use alternative distribution channels.

brands.name: The Look Salon Suites
brands.territoryDescription: A protected territory is granted based on population radius (1/4 to 2.5 miles) where the franchisor will not establish or license other brick-and-mortar studios, but the territory is not exclusive and franchisees may face competition from other channels or brands.

brands.name: Tommy's Express
brands.territoryDescription: The territory is a designated radius based on geographic analysis where the franchisor will not establish another business, but it is not exclusive and franchisees may face competition from other channels.

brands.name: Toro Taxes
brands.territoryDescription: The franchisor designates a territory around the approved site, generally the smaller of a one-mile radius or a population of 20,000, within which the franchisor will not open or grant another franchise, subject to reserved rights.

brands.name: Training Mate
brands.territoryDescription: The territory is typically a 3-mile radius from the studio location, defined by identifiable boundaries like ZIP codes or streets. It is non-exclusive, and the franchisor reserves rights to operate in 'Special Sites' and other channels.

brands.name: TA
brands.territoryDescription: The franchisee operates at a single approved site. A 'Protected Area' may be designated in Exhibit C, within which the franchisor will not grant others the right to operate a TA Center, but the territory is not exclusive.

brands.name: True REST
brands.territoryDescription: Franchisees receive a non-exclusive protected geographic area around the Authorized Location, typically a radius up to three miles in suburban environments or less than one mile in urban areas, where the franchisor will not operate or authorize other True REST franchises.

brands.name: Critter Control
brands.territoryDescription: Critter Control designates the franchisee's territory as defined in Section 1.01 and Exhibit B of the Franchise Agreement. The text does not explicitly state whether the territory is exclusive or non-exclusive, but implies a designated area of operation.

brands.name: Tumble Fresh Coin Laundry
brands.territoryDescription: The territory generally encompasses an area surrounding the location that is the lesser of 2 miles or an area encompassing 20,000 in population. The franchisor will not establish a company-owned or franchised outlet in this territory under the Tumble Fresh Coin Laundry name.

brands.name: Mr. Transmission
brands.territoryDescription: Franchisees receive a 3-mile radius protection where no other Mr. Transmission, Milex, or Co-Branded centers can be opened, but the territory is not exclusive.

brands.name: Tutu School
brands.territoryDescription: Franchisees receive a Preliminary Designated Area and a final Designated Area, but do not receive an exclusive territory and may face competition from other franchisees, company-owned outlets, or other channels.

brands.name: Two Men and a Truck
brands.territoryDescription: Franchisees are granted a protected territory (Marketing Area) defined by zip codes to locate their franchise and perform direct marketing. The size varies by market type, generally 420,000-600,000 population for Metro Market and 100,000-250,000 for Mod Market.

brands.name: U-Save Car & Truck Rental
brands.territoryDescription: The territory is determined on an individual basis based on demographics and other factors, with no minimum threshold. The franchisor reserves the right to operate other outlets or concepts within the territory and does not grant an exclusive territory.

brands.name: Uncle Louie G
brands.territoryDescription: Fixed location units are granted a non-exclusive operating area (typically 0.1 to 0.5 mile radius) designated by the franchisor; mobile units have no territory but are restricted from operating within fixed location operating areas or at protected events.

brands.name: Uni K Wax
brands.territoryDescription: The Franchise Agreement grants an exclusive territory with a minimum population of 25,000, typically around 50,000, identified in the Site Approval Notice or Franchise Agreement.

brands.name: urSwim
brands.territoryDescription: Franchisees are granted a non-exclusive operating territory generally comprising a geographic area with a population of approximately 40,000 to 45,000 children under age 14, subject to franchisor approval and market conditions.

brands.name: V's Barbershop
brands.territoryDescription: Franchisees do not receive an exclusive territory and may face competition from other franchisees or outlets. The Franchisor may market services and products within the Applicable Radius through other channels, including the Internet, without compensation to the franchisee.

brands.name: Valenta
brands.territoryDescription: The franchisee is granted a designated operating territory, generally a city, county, or metropolitan area containing at least 2,000 qualified businesses. The territory is not exclusive, and the franchisor reserves the right to add additional franchisees if the territory contains more than 2,000 qualified businesses.

brands.name: Valhallan
brands.territoryDescription: Territories are protected but not exclusive, generally ranging from a 1/2-mile to a 3-mile radius for Arenas and 1/2-mile to 4-mile radius for Studios, determined by the franchisor based on demographics and location factors.

brands.name: Valvoline Instant Oil Change Franchising, Inc
VaVia
brands.territoryDescription: Franchisees are granted a designated operating territory, generally consisting of a geographic area with a population of approximately 300,000 people. The franchisor will not open or grant another franchisee the right to operate within this territory during the term, provided the franchisee is not in default.

brands.name: Velox Valuations
brands.territoryDescription: Franchisee will not receive an exclusive territory but is protected from other Velox Valuations businesses in the territory, subject to franchisor's reservation of rights for national accounts and other channels.

brands.name: Veronica's Insurance
brands.territoryDescription: The franchisor will not establish or grant another franchisee the right to establish an Agency within the Designated Territory, generally a four-mile radius or 20,000 population, subject to reserved rights.

brands.name: VIO Med Spa
brands.territoryDescription: The franchisor grants a Designated Territory, generally the smaller of a 3-mile radius or a population of 75,000-100,000, within which the franchisor will not open or grant another franchisee the right to open a new VIO Med Spa.

brands.name: Willowbrae Academy
brands.territoryDescription: Franchisees do not receive an exclusive territory but are granted a 'Protected Area' where the franchisor will not establish or license another Willowbrae Academy Facility, provided the franchisee remains in compliance.

brands.name: Pet Supplies Plus
brands.territoryDescription: Franchisees are granted a protected area, generally defined as a radius around the approved location, within which the franchisor will not open another store. The territory is not exclusive, and franchisees may face competition from other franchisees or company-owned outlets.

brands.name: Wahlburgers
brands.territoryDescription: Franchisees do not receive an exclusive territory under the Franchise Agreement and may face competition from other franchisees, company-owned outlets, or other channels of distribution controlled by the franchisor.

brands.name: Water Babies
brands.territoryDescription: Franchisees are granted a non-exclusive territory based on demographics and population limits (minimum 50,000 children aged 9 and under), with the franchisor reserving rights to operate via other channels and potentially within the territory.

brands.name: WaveMAX Laundry
brands.territoryDescription: The territory typically includes an area bounded by a 2-mile radius from the location, subject to exceptions for high population density or geographical features. The franchisor promises not to establish a company-owned or franchised outlet selling the same or similar goods under the same or similar trademarks within this territory.

brands.name: Waxing the City
brands.territoryDescription: Franchisees receive a protected territory, not an exclusive one, defined by mapping and demographic software to include a population of no more than 50,000 people based on census projections.

brands.name: We Insure
brands.territoryDescription: The franchisee does not receive an exclusive territory and may face competition from other franchisees, company-owned outlets, or other channels. The franchisee is granted the right to operate at a specific approved location but is not geographically restricted from soliciting customers within or outside their state, subject to licensing.

brands.name: We Rock The Spectrum
brands.territoryDescription: Franchisees receive an exclusive territory defined in Exhibit A of the Franchise Agreement, within which the franchisor will not operate or franchise other gyms if the franchisee is in good standing.

brands.name: Whole Property Management
brands.territoryDescription: The territory is a specific geographic region defined by zip codes or boundaries with a minimum population of 125,000; it is non-exclusive, and the franchisor reserves the right to use other distribution channels within the territory.

brands.name: Windermere Real Estate Services Company A Washington
Wine and Design
brands.territoryDescription: Franchisees receive a protected area consisting of a 2-mile radius around the Studio and a limit of one studio per 50,000 persons in the MSA. The territory is not exclusive, and the franchisor reserves rights to sell through other channels.

brands.name: Wise Wonder Enrichment
brands.territoryDescription: Franchisees are granted a designated protected territory comprising zip codes with a population of approximately 200,000 people, subject to franchisor approval and adjustments.

brands.name: With A Twist
brands.territoryDescription: Franchisees are granted a Protected Territory, typically identified by zip codes or county lines with a population of approximately 1,000,000 or fewer. The franchisor will not operate or permit others to operate in this territory, subject to reserved rights and minimum sales requirements.

brands.name: World of Sourdough
brands.territoryDescription: Franchisees receive a protected territory within a 2-mile radius of their specific location, excluding malls, airports, and campuses. The franchisor reserves the right to grant larger or smaller territories based on population density.

brands.name: World Options
brands.territoryDescription: The franchisee will not receive an exclusive territory and may face competition from other franchisees, company-owned outlets, or other channels. The franchise is a non-exclusive license only.

brands.name: WorldKids School
brands.territoryDescription: The territory is a specific geographic region, normally a 5-mile radius, within which the franchisor promises not to establish company-owned or franchised outlets selling similar goods or services under similar trademarks.

brands.name: We Sell Restaurants
brands.territoryDescription: Franchisees receive a territory based on geographic or zip code boundaries containing a minimum of 500 restaurants. The franchisor retains the exclusive right to determine boundaries and may operate or license others within the territory for alternative channels or national accounts.

brands.name: Water Wings Swim School
brands.territoryDescription: The Protected Area is exclusive, determined by the franchisor based on zip codes, geographic boundaries, or radius. The franchisor will not operate or grant others the right to operate another Water Wings Swim School in the Protected Area during the term.

brands.name: XP League
brands.territoryDescription: Franchisees receive a Protected Area, not an exclusive territory, which may contain a minimum of 8,000 children aged 5-15. The franchisor retains the right to operate or license others within or outside this area.

brands.name: Xtension Envy
brands.territoryDescription: The franchisee receives an exclusive territory defined after site identification, where the franchisor will not open another outlet or grant rights to others, subject to the franchisee not being in default. The franchisor retains the right to sell through alternative distribution channels within the territory.

brands.name: Young Chefs Academy
brands.territoryDescription: Franchisees receive a protected territory, typically 5 driving miles from the premises, within which the franchisor will not place another Young Chefs Academy business. The territory is not exclusive as the franchisor reserves rights to sell via alternative channels and may face competition from other brands.

brands.name: YESCO
brands.territoryDescription: The territory is non-exclusive, typically delineated by county lines or zip codes, and contains approximately 10,000 businesses, subject to a minimum sales quota.

brands.name: yorCMO
brands.territoryDescription: Franchisees are not granted any territory rights or minimum territory and will not receive an exclusive or protected territory.

brands.name: Ziebart
brands.territoryDescription: New single-unit franchisees receive a protected area of a 10-mile radius for 3 years, contingent on meeting sales volume. The franchisor reserves rights to use other distribution channels within the protected area.

brands.name: ZIPS Cleaners
brands.territoryDescription: Franchisees do not receive an exclusive territory. They may face competition from other franchisees, company-owned outlets, or other channels. A 'Protected Area' (approx. 2-mile radius) is granted where ZIPS will not operate or license others, subject to specific exceptions.

brands.name: Zoom Drain
brands.territoryDescription: Territory is typically based on contiguous zip codes comprising approximately 300,000 individuals. The franchisor will not locate, operate, or grant another franchise within the Territory while the agreement is in force and not in default.
